name: onebrain
description: Private memory shared across a developer's agents, exposed as a remote MCP server. Explicit remember and recall. Shared spaces are opt-in.

steps: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http onebrain https://qlpfjeciekaqzribxlnp.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
claude_code.note: Run mcp get (or /mcp in a session) before login. That connect caches the metadata URL from the 401 WWW-Authenticate header. The lighter install is agent-install.sh with ONEBRAIN_API_KEY.
